dev.AH_E1/COL: dev size (5 per cell): no unit passes the gates there (RECOVERY.md, Bottom line). At larger sizes: fails by design at every size run (5–20 per cell): q is not identified on a two-valued channel (q = ½ always-positive + ½ always-negative), so the nulls are not testable, and the noise models are near-mixtures of the procedures
dev.AH_E1/ENT: dev size (5 per cell): no unit passes the gates there (RECOVERY.md, Bottom line). At larger sizes: fails by design at every size run (5–20 per cell): q is not identified on a two-valued channel (q = ½ always-positive + ½ always-negative), so the nulls are not testable, and the noise models are near-mixtures of the procedures

At larger sizes: fails by design at every size run (5–20 per cell): q is not identified on a two-valued channel (q = ½ always-positive + ½ always-negative), so the nulls are not testable, and the noise models are near-mixtures of the procedures
dev.AH_E2/COL: dev size (5 per cell): no unit passes the gates there (RECOVERY.md, Bottom line). At larger sizes: fails by design: as A/H E1
dev.AH_E2/ENT: dev size (5 per cell): no unit passes the gates there (RECOVERY.md, Bottom line). At larger sizes: fails by design: as A/H E1
dev.AH_E2/SAT: dev size (5 per cell): no unit passes the gates there (RECOVERY.md, Bottom line). At larger sizes: fails by design: as A/H E1
dev.AH_E5/COL: dev size (5 per cell): no unit passes the gates there (RECOVERY.md, Bottom line). At larger sizes: passes at 40 per cell (the mixture with either interval, and both nulls) but not at 20 (smallest coverage 0.86, median width 0.245; BCa 0.90, 0.239); no A/H E5 run at 40 per cell exists
dev.AH_E5/ENT: dev size (5 per cell): no unit passes the gates there (RECOVERY.md, Bottom line). At larger sizes: not reached by 40: bias and width pass from 20, but the 0.1 weight (B4 FIRST) covers 0.81 at 20 and 0.87 at 40 (BCa 0.88 at both); both nulls pass
dev.AH_E5/KNAP: dev size (5 per cell): no unit passes the gates there (RECOVERY.md, Bottom line). At larger sizes: no mixture test: fewer than three members on every item; null q fails coverage from 20 per cell on (the boundary)
dev.AH_E5/SAT: dev size (5 per cell): no unit passes the gates there (RECOVERY.md, Bottom line). At larger sizes: passes at 20 per cell; fitted on the 20-per-cell runs
dev.B4C4_E1/entailment: dev size (5 per cell): no unit passes the gates there (RECOVERY.md, Bottom line). At larger sizes: fails by design (run at dev size only): NOISY-EXACT is nearly the EXACT group (σ_min/σ_max = 0.0004)
dev.B4C4_E2/entailment: dev size (5 per cell): no unit passes the gates there (RECOVERY.md, Bottom line). At larger sizes: fails by design (run at dev size only): five linear dependencies, one of them among procedures (the H6 gap)
dev.C_E1/3-SAT: dev size (5 per cell): no unit passes the gates there (RECOVERY.md, Bottom line). At larger sizes: the mixture passes only with BCa intervals (0.92 at 20, 0.90 at 40); with percentile intervals the 0.1 ALWAYS-UNSAT weight covers 0.86 at 20 and 0.79 at 40; null q fails at every size (the boundary)
dev.C_E1/colouring: dev size (5 per cell): no unit passes the gates there (RECOVERY.md, Bottom line). At larger sizes: the mixture passes only with BCa intervals, at 20 (0.91); with percentile intervals it covers 0.88 at 20 and 0.87 at 40; null ALWAYS fails at every size, by design (the one-colour answer goes to LOCAL-2-ID)
dev.C_E2/3-SAT: dev size (5 per cell): no unit passes the gates there (RECOVERY.md, Bottom line). At larger sizes: the mixture passes at 40 per cell but not at 20 (coverage 0.88, median width 0.28), and null q fails at every size (0.88 at 40), so the three never pass together
dev.C_E2/colouring: dev size (5 per cell): no unit passes the gates there (RECOVERY.md, Bottom line). At larger sizes: passes at 20 per cell; fitted on the 20-per-cell runs
dev.C_E2/knapsack: dev size (5 per cell): no unit passes the gates there (RECOVERY.md, Bottom line). At larger sizes: passes at 20 per cell; fitted on the 20-per-cell runs
dev.C_E3/colouring (gadget): dev size (5 per cell): no unit passes the gates there (RECOVERY.md, Bottom line). At larger sizes: fails by design (run at dev size only): DPLL-LIST = FF-LIST and six LOCAL-t proxies span only six directions, so the mixture is not testable, and null q loads 0.41 on members
dev.C_E5/3-SAT: dev size (5 per cell): no unit passes the gates there (RECOVERY.md, Bottom line). At larger sizes: not reached by 40: at 40 per cell the median width is 0.24 and the 0.1 weight's coverage 0.89
dev.C_E5/3-SAT (partial assignment given): dev size (5 per cell): no unit passes the gates there (RECOVERY.md, Bottom line). At larger sizes: passes at 40 per cell; fitted on the 40-per-cell runs
dev.C_E5/colouring (k=3): dev size (5 per cell): no unit passes the gates there (RECOVERY.md, Bottom line). At larger sizes: fails at these sizes by a near-tie (FF-3-EDGE-MENTION-ABORT against ALWAYS-IMPOSSIBLE = PHANTOM-ADJACENT): coverage 0.48 at 20; at 40, coverage 0.89 but median width 0.46
dev.C_E5/colouring (k=3, partial colouring g: dev size (5 per cell): no unit passes the gates there (RECOVERY.md, Bottom line). At larger sizes: not reached by 40: bias and coverage pass at 40, but the median width is 0.27, and null q fails at every size
dev.C_E5/propositional entailment: dev size (5 per cell): no unit passes the gates there (RECOVERY.md, Bottom line). At larger sizes: fails by design: q and NOISY-EXACT are combinations of other members, and the EXACT group answers 'does not follow' on every item (mixture bias 0.08–0.13 at every size)

schema.descriptive: run_id -> unit -> categories, ok, correct, accuracy_of_ok, valid / valid_defined, members_matched and sets_matched ([{members, answers, share_of_ok}], members matching the same answers merged), wrong_member_match, special_answers, token medians, truncated_by_cell
schema.fits: unit -> run_id -> fit_unit's report (fit.weights: pi with percentile lo/hi, or 'not identified' with a range; eps, rho with intervals; identifiability; diagnostics; excluded; error_agreement and weight_lift with permutation baselines) plus bca ({group: [lo, hi]}), ea_counts, q_exact_chance_log10_max, near, reach, lumps, unit_facts, special_check, seed, item_set
schema.gated_units: item set -> the units fitted at that size; every other unit is descriptive only (not_fitted gives why)
schema.not_fitted: item set -> unit -> why it is descriptive only there, from RECOVERY.md's verdicts; a dev entry also gives the unit's status at larger sizes
schema.recovery_at_estimate: unit -> run_id -> fake models planted at the fitted mixture: per-quantity truth, mean, bias, coverage and width (percentile and BCa), gate verdicts, and the simulated reach statistics
schema.runs: one entry per discovered run: run_id, label, item_set, model, condition, effort, reasoning, max_tokens, providers_served, n_records, from_cache, spent_usd (API-reported), scorer, run and scorer git SHAs, scored_sha256, item_drift (per item file: the manifest's sha256 and the current file's)
schema.skipped_runs: directories matching the run patterns that have no scored records yet (in progress)

settings.intervals: percentile cluster bootstrap (primary) and BCa from the same draws
